project.name: ISL-Speak Mobile Lens
project.objective: Rebuild the current Streamlit demo into a professional Android and iOS camera-first mobile application that detects Indian Sign Language gestures continuously and displays live translation captions below the camera, similar in simplicity and responsiveness to Google Lens.

current_state.current_frontend: Streamlit web app with WebRTC tab, upload tab, vocabulary tab, analytics tab, and architecture tab
current_state.current_model_pipeline: MediaPipe Holistic landmarks, 45-frame rolling window, PyTorch BiLSTM or Transformer classifier, majority-vote sentence buffer, optional text-to-speech
critical_limitations: Streamlit is not the right runtime for a smooth Android/iOS production camera experience.
The live WebRTC callback processes frames but the UI caption widgets are not reliably updated from that async callback.
The interface is feature-heavy for a real user: model tabs, analytics, vocabulary explorer, upload mode, and demo badges distract from live translation.
Detection waits for a full 45-frame sequence and only runs every 4 frames, which creates startup delay and can feel like no detection.
The model may silently run with default random weights if checkpoints are missing, which makes detection appear broken instead of failing visibly.
No mobile model format exists yet; PyTorch checkpoints must be exported or wrapped for mobile inference.
No formal accuracy, latency, device, or lighting test kit is currently defined.

product_principles: Camera is the product, not a feature inside a dashboard.
The first screen must immediately invite capture and translation.
Live caption must be visible below the camera at all times.
Controls must be minimal: camera flip, sound, clear caption, settings.
Detection status must be honest: scanning, hand not visible, low confidence, translated.
The app must run on real Android and iOS devices, not only desktop browsers.
Accessibility must be first-class: readable captions, high contrast, haptics, large tap targets, offline-first behavior, and low-friction permissions.

primary_flow: Permission request appears only when needed and explains camera usage clearly.
A stable caption strip appears below the camera.
The app shows immediate status: scanning, detected hand, recognizing, or translated text.
When a gesture is accepted, caption updates and optional speech plays.
User can clear the caption, pause detection, flip camera, or mute speech with one tap.

visual_direction.style: Professional, calm, camera-first, high contrast, no neon/glassmorphism demo styling.
visual_direction.inspiration: Google Lens-like simplicity: live camera preview, light overlays, clear bottom caption.

layout.top_bar: Small brand text and status indicator only.
layout.camera_area: Full-bleed preview with optional subtle hand guide frame.
layout.caption_area: Persistent bottom caption panel outside or over the lower camera safe area.
layout.controls: Icon buttons for flip camera, mute, clear, history, settings.

remove_visual_noise: No metric cards during normal use.
No badges advertising model accuracy on the capture screen.
No analytics charts in the main app experience.
No tabbed research dashboard as the primary interface.
No cluttered OpenCV HUD baked into the camera frame.

remove_from_primary_mobile_app.reason: End users should not choose between BiLSTM and Transformer. Ship one validated production model.
Expose calibrated modes instead: balanced, faster, stricter. Keep exact threshold in developer settings only.
Useful for documentation, not the live camera surface. Move to settings/help.
Belongs in internal QA dashboard, not user-facing mobile app.
Belongs in README, website, or about page.
Useful for QA and dataset collection, but not needed for first mobile release.
Native UI captions are more readable, localizable, accessible, and responsive.
Production target is Android/iOS native camera, not desktop capture.

mobile_client.recommended_stack: React Native with Expo Dev Client or bare React Native

alternatives.when_to_choose: If the team strongly prefers Dart and wants one rendering stack with mature camera plugins.
If maximum device performance and platform-specific ML integration are more important than shared UI code.

core_libraries: react-native-worklets-core for frame processing off the UI thread
MediaPipe Tasks Vision or platform-native MediaPipe graph for hand/pose landmarks
ONNX Runtime Mobile or TensorFlow Lite for classifier inference
Native text-to-speech APIs: AVSpeechSynthesizer on iOS and TextToSpeech on Android

ml_runtime.preferred_path: Export trained sequence classifier to ONNX, validate numerical parity, then run with ONNX Runtime Mobile.
ml_runtime.fallback_path: Export to TensorFlow Lite if MediaPipe/TFLite integration becomes simpler for mobile deployment.
ml_runtime.inference_location: On-device for privacy, latency, offline use, and app-store friendliness.
ml_runtime.server_inference_policy: Do not depend on server inference for MVP. Optional cloud evaluation can exist only as opt-in developer tooling.

backend.mvp: No backend required for live translation.
future_optional_services: Model update manifest and staged rollout

responsibilities: Request and persist camera permission state.

Support camera flip.
Provide frame stream at controlled resolution.
Keep preview responsive even if inference slows.

requirements.mirroring: Front camera preview may be mirrored, but landmark coordinates passed to model must match training orientation policy.

responsibilities: Detect pose and both hands from camera frames.
Emit exactly 258 features per processed frame to match the trained model.
Report landmark quality signals: left hand visible, right hand visible, pose visible, tracking confidence.
Normalize coordinates consistently with training.

requirements.missing_landmarks: Use zero vectors only when missing landmarks are expected and model was trained with the same policy.
requirements.quality_gate: Do not classify if no hand is visible for a minimum number of recent frames.

risk_items: MediaPipe Python Holistic behavior may not match MediaPipe mobile task outputs exactly.
Left/right hand assignment can change under mirrored camera previews.
Different camera focal lengths and lighting can shift landmarks enough to reduce accuracy.

Warm up quickly and show progress while filling.
Run inference at stride tuned for latency and battery.
Segment gestures from idle or transition motion.
recommended_changes: Add warm-up caption: hold gesture for N frames.
Add motion stability scoring before accepting a prediction.
Add idle/background class or gesture-boundary detector.
Keep multiple recent logits for smoothing instead of only majority vote labels.

acceptance_rules.duplicate_suppression: Do not append same word repeatedly unless user resets or a clear gesture boundary occurs.
acceptance_rules.low_confidence_behavior: Show scanning or suggestion state, never append uncertain text.

Use platform-native voices.

requirements.latency: Speech starts within 300 ms after acceptance.
requirements.privacy: No network TTS dependency in MVP.

Show top-k probabilities.

implementation_stages.name: Detection Triage In Current Prototype
implementation_stages.goal: Prove whether the current checkpoint, landmark extractor, and label map can produce correct predictions before rebuilding mobile.
tasks: Add startup validation that checkpoint exists, label count matches model output, and model is in eval mode.
Add a debug method that runs inference on known validation landmark samples and prints top-5 predictions.
Test 20 known .npy files from data/landmarks and verify predicted labels.
Add visible errors instead of silently using random default weights.
Lower temporary threshold to 0.30 only for diagnosis, not production.
Log landmark visibility counts per frame to confirm hands are detected.
Verify whether camera preview is mirrored compared with training videos.
Measure time until first prediction with 45-frame window.
exit_criteria: Known landmark samples classify correctly above target confidence.
Live camera shows hands detected in at least 80 percent of frames during a clear gesture.
Model asset mismatch and missing checkpoint cases fail loudly.

implementation_stages.name: Simplify Web Prototype To Lens UI
implementation_stages.goal: Remove demo clutter and make the current app express the target product shape.
tasks: Replace tabs with one Live Translation screen.
Move upload, analytics, vocabulary, and architecture pages to internal/dev mode or remove from app.
Remove neon/glassmorphism styling.
Use a full-width camera area and persistent caption below it.
Display detection state next to caption.
Add clear caption, mute, reset detection, and camera start controls.
Update async WebRTC state handling so predictions appear in the caption area.
Add checkpoint/model health status.
exit_criteria: User can open the page, start camera, sign, and see caption below camera without visiting any other tab.
No research-dashboard elements appear in the normal user flow.

implementation_stages.name: Model Export And Parity
implementation_stages.goal: Create a mobile-loadable model with verified parity against PyTorch.
tasks: Write export script for BiLSTM checkpoint to ONNX with input shape 1x45x258.
Export dynamic batch optional, fixed sequence length mandatory.
Create model_manifest.json with version, class count, seq_len, feature_count, training date, and thresholds.
Run PyTorch vs ONNX parity on at least 500 validation samples.
Quantize INT8 or FP16 variant and compare accuracy and latency.
Select production model based on accuracy, latency, size, and stability.
Bundle label map and normalization stats.
exit_criteria: ONNX top-1 agreement with PyTorch is at least 99 percent on validation subset.
Mobile model package loads in a standalone inference test.
Accuracy drop after quantization is less than 1.5 percentage points, or quantization is deferred.

implementation_stages.name: Mobile App Foundation
implementation_stages.goal: Build the real Android/iOS client shell.
tasks: Create React Native app structure.
Add camera permission flow.
Add full-screen camera preview.
Add bottom caption panel respecting safe areas.
Add minimal controls: flip camera, mute, clear, settings.
Add app theming with professional accessible colors.
Add navigation only where needed.
Add crash-safe model asset loading.
exit_criteria: Runs on a real Android device.
Runs on a real iPhone.
Camera preview remains smooth while the caption UI updates.

implementation_stages.name: On-Device Landmark And Inference Integration
implementation_stages.goal: Connect camera frames to landmarks, sequence buffer, classifier, and caption engine on-device.
tasks: Integrate MediaPipe mobile landmark extraction.
Map mobile landmarks to the exact 258-feature format.
Implement rolling sequence buffer.
Run ONNX inference off the UI thread.
Implement smoothing and acceptance logic.
Update caption in native UI.
Add TTS for accepted predictions.
Add debug overlay toggle for landmarks and top-k labels.
exit_criteria: A known trained gesture updates caption on Android and iOS.
Median end-to-end latency is under 250 ms after warm-up on mid-range Android.
UI thread remains responsive during inference.

implementation_stages.name: Accuracy Hardening
implementation_stages.goal: Make detection reliable for real users, not just validation files.
tasks: Create real-device test set across users, lighting, backgrounds, skin tones, distance, and camera orientations.
Add idle/background samples.
Add hand visibility quality gates.
Calibrate confidence thresholds per class.
Tune smoothing window and stride.
Analyze confusion pairs and collect targeted data.
Retrain with mobile-captured landmarks if domain shift is high.
Add data augmentation: coordinate noise, frame drop, temporal speed changes, mirror policy, scale/translation jitter.
exit_criteria: Per-class F1 reaches target for launch vocabulary.
False caption insertion rate is below agreed threshold during idle movement.
Model works in indoor daylight, warm artificial light, and moderate low light.

implementation_stages.name: Production Readiness
implementation_stages.goal: Prepare the app for beta distribution and app-store review.
tasks: Add privacy policy and camera usage copy.
Add offline-first guarantee messaging.
Add app icons and launch screens.
Add build pipelines for Android and iOS.
Add error reporting without collecting video by default.
Add performance telemetry only with privacy-safe metrics.
Run accessibility audit.
Run battery and thermal tests.
Prepare TestFlight and Google Play internal testing releases.
exit_criteria: Installable builds are available for Android and iOS testers.
No video frames leave the device in MVP.
Known critical crashes are zero for beta test pass.

frame_processing_loop.description: Process camera frames at a controlled inference FPS while keeping preview at native FPS.
steps: Downscale or crop to landmark extractor input size.
Run landmark extraction off UI thread.
If quality is below gate, update state to hand_not_visible or hold_steady.
When sequence is full and stride condition is met, run classifier.
Smooth logits over recent inference windows.
Apply confidence and stability acceptance rules.

landmark_quality_score.formula: weighted_score = hand_presence_weight + tracking_weight + bbox_weight + brightness_weight - blur_penalty

prediction_smoothing.method: Temporal logit smoothing plus stable top-1 confirmation
rules: Accept only if the same label remains top-1 for stable_windows_required windows.
Reject background and idle labels from caption.
Suppress duplicate words until a boundary or cooldown occurs.
Clear unstable low-confidence candidates from the visible final caption.

gesture_boundary_detection.future: Train a separate boundary/idle detector or include a background class.

calibration.method: Temperature scaling and per-class threshold tuning on validation and real-device sets.

unit_tests: Missing landmarks produce expected zero sections.
Label map count matches model output classes.
Caption engine state transitions are deterministic.
Model asset loader fails visibly on missing files.
model_tests: PyTorch checkpoint loads and predicts known validation samples.
ONNX parity top-1 agreement against PyTorch.
mobile_integration_tests: Low-memory restart does not corrupt state.
ux_tests: First-time user can start detection without instruction.
Caption remains readable with one hand holding phone.
No important text overlaps safe areas.
User understands when hand is not visible.
User understands when confidence is low.
Clear caption action is obvious but not accidentally triggered.

mvp_internal.offline_test_accuracy: >= 90 percent on held-out landmark test split

production.real_device_top1_accuracy: >= 92 percent for supported vocabulary and conditions

immediate_actions: Audit existing labels for duplicates, casing differences, and numeric prefixes.
Count samples per class and flag imbalance.
Run confusion analysis on current checkpoints.
Capture the same gestures using front and rear cameras.
Capture multiple users and lighting conditions.
Add idle, transition, and non-sign hand movement samples.
quality_filters: Reject samples with no detectable hand landmarks for more than 50 percent of frames.
Reject mislabeled or ambiguous gesture clips after human review.
Keep signer-disjoint train/validation/test split to avoid inflated accuracy.

privacy: Do not upload video by default.
Do not store captured clips unless user explicitly chooses to submit or save.
Keep telemetry free of raw frames and biometric landmark traces unless consented for research.
permissions: Network not required for MVP translation.
accessibility: Haptic confirmation when word is accepted.
Voice output optional and easily muted.
No essential information conveyed only through color.

risks_and_implications.risk: Research accuracy does not transfer to mobile live camera.
risks_and_implications.implication: The app may appear broken even if notebook accuracy is high.
risks_and_implications.mitigation: Build real-device test set and retrain/calibrate with mobile landmark distribution.

risks_and_implications.risk: MediaPipe mobile landmarks differ from Python Holistic landmarks.
risks_and_implications.implication: Model input distribution shifts and predictions degrade.
risks_and_implications.mitigation: Compare Python vs mobile landmark vectors on the same test clips and normalize mapping exactly.

risks_and_implications.implication: Users think detection is not working.
risks_and_implications.mitigation: Show warm-up status, tune inference FPS, evaluate shorter sequence models, and use streaming smoothing.

risks_and_implications.implication: Random hand motion may be converted into words.
risks_and_implications.mitigation: Add background samples and boundary detection.

risks_and_implications.risk: Too many gesture classes for limited data.
risks_and_implications.mitigation: Ship a smaller reliable launch vocabulary first, then expand.
Throttle inference FPS, use quantized model, avoid UI-thread work, benchmark devices.

risks_and_implications.implication: The app feels like a project demo, not an assistive tool.
risks_and_implications.mitigation: Keep technical details in internal debug mode and make camera plus caption the core.

prototype_fix: Current prototype visibly detects known gestures or reports exact failure reason.
Unwanted demo tabs are removed or hidden.
mobile_mvp: Android and iOS builds run on real devices.
Core UX is clean and accessible.
Internal debug mode can diagnose landmark and prediction issues.
beta_release: Accuracy targets are met on real-device test kit.
Latency and battery targets are met.
Privacy policy and app permissions are ready.
Crash rate is acceptable for external testers.
Known unsupported conditions are documented inside release notes, not buried in code.
